name: Lemon-Dill Tuna Toasts with Bell Pepper, Artichoke & Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
1 red bell pepper
½ English cucumber
½ small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemon. Divide between two medium bowls, then set one bowl aside for later use.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the remaining medium bowl with the lemon.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts; drain olives. Add both to the bowl, along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine the veggie salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (106 g) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
½ (108 g) can sliced black olives
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the reserved bowl with the lemon.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
⅛ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
¼ tsp oregano, dried
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the dressing, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (120 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)

Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan, then drizzle with oil. Place in the oven, and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes. Remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 slices sourdough bread
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Spread the tuna salad over each toast, then top with a small portion of the veggie salad.
Divide toast between plates and serve with remaining salad on the side. Enjoy!
